claim: Recomputed 252 complete exact W05 fill witnesses and 504 rational diagnostic economic gaps.
assumptions: Frozen ZIP pair verified; independent fill recurrence on supplied inputs.
falsifier: Any unequal action or rational gap fraction.

claim: Exactly zero matched-service/stock cost opportunity in all 252 W05 cases and 12 coupled paths.
assumptions: W05 tariff, battery model, each fill attains the discharge envelope.
falsifier: Positive excess cumulative discharge invalidates this saturation argument.

claim: At original W05 scale single horizon inventory ceiling at most $1,175.54 subject to discharge saturation; four 30-day splices each bound at $39.19/day (rounded up).
assumptions: Nonnegative stock/cycling coefficients, matched hourly service and state ceiling 180, final floor 95 MWh.
falsifier: Variable pricing, mismatched service or unverified additional cycling.

claim: Against price rule, mean fresh perfect-foresight headroom $100.91/$83.18 per site-day at 7/30 days.
assumptions: Finite declared action lattice, equal terminal 9 MWh and complete hourly service.
falsifier: Any cheaper-than-bound feasible path or invalid recomputed potential.

claim: Checked 8,260,320 finite-plant Bellman edges over 128 offline objectives and reconstructed attaining paths.
assumptions: Full declared finite state-action graph with known exogenous trajectory for the lower bound.
falsifier: Inconsistent value recursion, lower-bound direction, or unmatched attaining path.

claim: Fresh flat-tariff optimal stock-only value $4.21/$0.67 per day, versus $28.43/$26.63 under artificial daily resets.
assumptions: Fresh 12 MWh site, exact hourly service, $50 credit; horizon-average units.
falsifier: A change of fixed terminal or queue/calendar conditions produces a different contrast.

claim: On continuous variable-price paths optimal stock-only effect averaged $25.39/$7.35 per day.
assumptions: Matched fill terminal versus floor, $50 closing credit and same service/wear/reserve model.
falsifier: End-credit or reserve-capacity definition changes the estimand.

claim: H12 fitted terminal mark gains $55.32/$40.45 per day against the price rule and $46.96/$48.40 against H12 zero tail.
assumptions: Confirmed eight synthetic seed groups and paired 7/30-day paths; common forecasts, duty and stock.
falsifier: Any changed service, terminal, undisclosed forecast, or evaluation leakage.

claim: All four sign tests on improvement exceeding $15/day have Holm-adjusted p=0.015625.
assumptions: One-sided independent seed-level sign tests under synthetic-generator null; paired horizons, familywise Holm.
falsifier: Extrapolation beyond the generator or use of per-hour pseudo-replicates.

claim: The fitted mark loses to a stronger 3-scenario H12 comparator on mean ($2.03/$2.35 per day); no case beats it by $15.
assumptions: Supplement locked after the main comparisons, same issues, terminal mark and physical contract.
falsifier: Candidate beats the stronger stochastic comparator on future preregistered paths.

claim: Applied all jobs and protected service with verified headroom and final 9 MWh for each matched controller. Pending booked work crossed all 280 internal midnights.
assumptions: Outages suspend contracted reserve during zero power; booked jobs and firm feeder.
falsifier: Queue, action, protected dispatch, reserve or end-stock failure.

assumptions: Separate contract allows shedding, $18 penalty per unserved low job.

claim: 83 primary guard fallbacks occurred; zero measured one-second misses out of 42624 primary/diagnostic decisions.
assumptions: Single machine; includes the diagnostic free-fill trajectory and per-step validation.
falsifier: Timing/host dependence or unchecked unsafe applied fallback.

claim: All 24 explicit time-expanded HiGHS LP objectives matched exact rolling H12 and admitted applied actions.
assumptions: First 24 epochs selected by separate supplemental protocol, first 7-day path, no terminal guard binding.
falsifier: Numerical LP objective disagreement or first action outside optimal set.

assumptions: Synthetic prices, reserve availability only, illustrative wear and job values; costs to deploy unknown.
